title: Method and system for determining in-cycle a pilot injection fuel mass in a combustion chamber of an engine
summary: Developed a method to determine in-cycle pilot injection fuel mass based on pressure, possible start of vaporization, and possible start of combustion. This method is applicable to controlling injection to a combustion chamber, a second combustion chamber, a system for determining fuel mass, a vehicle, a computer program product, and a computer-readable storage medium.

title: Method and system for fuel pump regulation
summary: Invented a method for fuel pump control in a fuel system, also applicable to a system, vehicle, computer program, and computer program product.

title: System and method for improving heat release evaluation at a reciprocating internal combustion engine
summary: Created a method for improving heat release evaluation in a reciprocating combustion engine by providing a model for volume deviations based on dynamic parameters, determining these parameters, and using an adaptation model to improve engine control and/or diagnostics.

title: Method and system for diagnosing a fuel system II
summary: Developed a method for diagnosing a fuel system in a vehicle by filtering pressure sensor signals and determining fuel flow errors. This method is applicable to vehicles with combustion engines and multiple fuel pumps.

title: Method and system for diagnosing a fuel system
summary: Invented a method for diagnosing a fuel system in a vehicle by determining the presence of fuel flow errors based on the power consumption of fuel pumps. This method is applicable to vehicles with combustion engines and multiple fuel pumps.
